entry.title: dotnet/runtime - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-12-24
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Dispose of custom enumerator not getting called if `UseSizeOptimizedLinq` is used #122725
  • Application Crashes when init MATLAB dll #122724
  • `dotnet-host-10.0.1-1.fc43.x86_64` uniquely `ABRT`'d when its host terminal `SEGV`'d. #122721
  • Test failure: System.Security.Cryptography.Dsa.Tests.DsaArrayOffsetSignatureFormatTests.OffsetAndCountOutOfRange #122720
  • Version for package `Microsoft.XmlSerializer.Generator` could not be resolved. #122719

Closed

  • Replace usages of templating mechanism inside msbuild code paths with GenerateFileFromTemplate #53959
  • Unexpected exception in TimingPipeFlusher.FlushAsync in Kestrel #120478
  • TickCount64's Fixed ~15ms Resolution Hurts .NET's Semi-Realtime Responsiveness Despite timeBeginPeriod(1) #122680
  • GeneratedCodeAttribute does not allow multiple #122718
  • JIT: Redundant bounds check when iterating over many spans with equal length #122696
  • Unify CoreLib/System.Runtime.Numerics formatting/parsing code #28657

PullRequests

Created

  • Handle more async nodes on community platforms #122727
    area-CodeGen-coreclr, community-contribution, arch-loongarch64, arch-riscv
  • [ThreadPool] Scalability Experiments follow up. Part1 #122726
    area-System.Threading
  • Move stgpool to md subsystem, extract memory streams, and eliminate CDescPool dependency on StgPool #122723
    area-VM-coreclr
  • [WIP] [Draft] runtime-async Exception.ToString() #122722
    area-ExceptionHandling-coreclr, runtime-async

Merged

  • Use QueryUnbiasedInterruptTime instead of GetTickCount64 to allow more responsive Windows apps when they opt-in #122706
    area-System.Threading, breaking-change, needs-breaking-change-doc-created

Updated

  • Generate calls to interface methods through resolve helper #122639
    area-NativeAOT-coreclr
  • [wasm][coreclr] Do not try to probe .ni.dll assemblies #122643
    area-AssemblyLoader-coreclr, Future
  • [release/10.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #122554
    area-codeflow
  • Resolve dllimport.cpp runtimeasync todos #122466
    area-Interop-coreclr, runtime-async
  • Refactor lock upgrade logic #122571
    area-VM-coreclr
  • [clr-interp] Interpreter for ARM32 SOFTFP #120688
    area-VM-coreclr, community-contribution, area-CodeGen-Interpreter-coreclr
  • Fix Mono Debugger 200ms Pause (Issue #122344) #122449
    area-Debugger-mono, community-contribution
  • Handle OpenSSL config errors gracefully in DetectCiphersuiteConfiguration #122569
